name: Breakthrough Advertising
tagline: Work through Schwartz's advertising classic and leave with angles and drafts
description: Describe what you are selling, who it is for, and where the ad will run, and it answers with angles worth testing, headline options, and first-draft copy to react to. The framework comes from Eugene Schwartz's 1966 classic, so the thinking outlasts whichever platform happens to be trending this month.
